import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DB_PATH = os.environ.get('TASKS_DB', 'tasks.db')

@tool
def delete_sprint_and_its_tasks(sprint_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            exists = conn.execute('SELECT 1 FROM sprints WHERE id = ?', (sprint_id,)).fetchone()
            if not exists:
                return f'Sprint {sprint_id} not found'
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM comments WHERE task_id IN (SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ?)', (sprint_id,))
            cur = conn.execute('DELETE FROM tasks WHERE sprint_id = ?', (sprint_id,))
            n_tasks = cur.rowcount
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM sprints WHERE id = ?', (sprint_id,))
            conn.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deletion_log (sprint_id INTEGER, task_count INTEGER, deleted_at TEXT)')
            conn.execute("INSERT INTO deletion_log (sprint_id, task_count, deleted_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))", (sprint_id, n_tasks))
    return f'Deleted sprint {sprint_id} and {n_tasks} tasks'
